scripts.build:android: npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.build:android:release: npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.build:ios:ipa: npx cap sync ios && xcodebuild -workspace ios/App/App.xcworkspace -scheme App -configuration Release -sdk iphoneos -archivePath build/Mori.xcarchive archive CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO CODE_SIGNING_REQUIRED=NO CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY="" && mkdir -p Payload && cp -r build/Mori.xcarchive/Products/Applications/App.app Payload/ && zip -r "Mori v4.3.1.ipa" Payload && rm -rf Payload build
scripts.build:macos: npm run tauri:build && rm -rf /tmp/dmg_build && mkdir -p /tmp/dmg_build && cp -r src-tauri/target/release/bundle/macos/Mori.app /tmp/dmg_build/ && cp src-tauri/README.txt /tmp/dmg_build/ && ln -s /Applications /tmp/dmg_build/Applications && hdiutil create -volname "Mori" -srcfolder /tmp/dmg_build -ov -format UDZO "Mori-v4.3.1-macOS-arm64.dmg" && rm -rf /tmp/dmg_build && tar -czf "Mori-v4.3.1-macOS-arm64.app.tar.gz" -C src-tauri/target/release/bundle/macos Mori.app
